definitions.explanation: Rolling from one position to another while sleeping.
Switching sides or betraying one's allies.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{寝返|ねがえ}りを{打|う}った。
{寝返|ねがえ}りがしやすいベッドが{欲|ほ}しい。
examples.english: I want a bed that's easy to turn over in.

examples.japanese: {夜中|よなか}に{何度|なんど}も{寝返|ねがえ}りを{打|う}って、よく{眠|ねむ}れなかった。
examples.english: I rolled over many times in the middle of the night and couldn't sleep well.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{初|はじ}めて{寝返|ねがえ}りをした{時|とき}、{家族|かぞく}みんなで{喜|よろこ}んだ。
examples.english: When the baby rolled over for the first time, the whole family celebrated.

examples.japanese: {味方|みかた}が{敵|てき}に{寝返|ねがえ}った。
examples.english: Our ally defected to the enemy.

examples.japanese: {部下|ぶか}が{寝返|ねがえ}った。
{戦|たたか}いの{途中|とちゅう}で{大|おお}きな{軍勢|ぐんぜい}が{寝返|ねがえ}った。
examples.english: A large army defected in the middle of the battle.

examples.japanese: {信頼|しんらい}していた{仲間|なかま}に{寝返|ねがえ}られて、とても{悔|くや}しかった。
examples.english: I was very frustrated when a trusted companion betrayed me.

examples.japanese: {有利|ゆうり}な{条件|じょうけん}を{出|だ}されて{寝返|ねがえ}る{者|もの}が{続出|ぞくしゅつ}した。
examples.english: People who defected after being offered favorable terms came one after another.

notes:
{寝返|ねがえ}り has both a literal physical meaning and a figurative meaning of betrayal.

PHYSICAL MEANING:
Rolling over in bed while sleeping. An important developmental milestone for babies ({赤|あか}ちゃんの{寝返|ねがえ}り).

FIGURATIVE MEANING:
Betray, defect, switch sides. The image is of "turning over" one's allegiance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {寝返|ねがえ}りを{打|う}つ: to roll over (physical) / to defect (figurative)
- {寝返|ねがえ}りができる: able to roll over (baby milestone)
- {敵|てき}に{寝返|ねがえ}る: to defect to the enemy

RELATED WORDS:
- {裏切|うらぎ}り: betrayal (more direct/harsh)
- {寝|ね}る: to sleep (component verb)
- {返|かえ}る: to return (component verb)
